reply.text: I'll pull your bench history so I can see where it has stalled. Nothing is logged for bench yet, so I can't see where it has stalled. Log a few sessions with your working sets and weights and I'll read the trend with you. In the meantime, the usual ways past a bench plateau are a small increase in weight on your top set, adding a rep or two at the same weight before moving up, and a deload week every so often when your sets start feeling heavy for no clear reason. Tell me your recent top sets (weight times reps) and I'll get more specific.
